title: Rethinking Demonstration Unlearning in Imitation Learning for Robotics
description:
arXiv:2608.20784v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Imitation learning for robotics depends on human demonstrations, some of which people may later ask to remove. Retraining without them is the natural reference, but its cost grows with policy and dataset scale, motivating cheaper operators that edit a trained policy.
